parsed.rationale: Both `LCDMinOffsetKey` and `LCDMaxOffsetKey` are type-alias-objects in the same file (`AccentColorEnvironment.swift`) within the `PlayerHeaderView` package, separated by only four lines (31 and 35). They represent structurally similar but semantically distinct SwiftUI environment key types — one for a minimum offset and one for a maximum offset — whose parallel shape is intentional by design. No fields are listed (`fields_or_signature: []`), so there is no shared implementation body to consolidate, and merging or abstracting them would obscure the distinct semantic roles each key plays in the environment value system.
